eligibility.methodological_eligibility.quote: Based on the presented there is need in terms of energy management to define a reference level as known as a condition, that takes into account all the specifications of the above and suggests a level of such data, which will be assessed against the newly acquired data from devices in the respective organizations administered by the observed local government.
